events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What's your favourite iconic performance from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who died in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock Remembered
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music still moves us. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the tragic death of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since the music world lost Tupac Shakur. His words and beats continue to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the legendary Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing and released 'Abbey Road'. Still an absolute masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't ignore him. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Legacy
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music forever, in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we carried our music. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring spirit and timeless music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in the UK in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
